content.text:
=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story foundation
summary:      Stand up the Python project tree, environment, pytest runner, and the `ledger` launcher at the application root.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     ledger executable, bin/test.sh launcher contract
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Create pyproject.toml, the committed uv.lock, the .venv-activating launchers in bin/, and an
  executable `ledger` at the application root that calls cli.main and exits with its return value.
  Record module ownership: persistence is reached only through the shipped persistence package.
  Money is integer cents at every layer; no floating point.

## story database
summary:      Declare accounts, categories, and transactions and every repository operation the ledger needs.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
stack:        python.md, persistence.md, sqlite.md
provides:     accounts table, categories table, transactions table
depends:      foundation
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Author the declaration only; Drydock generates the persistence package. Declare the three tables
  with integer-cent amounts, keys, and foreign keys from the source, and one access pattern per
  operation any story needs (get, list, create, update, delete, counts, sums, drop and recreate
  support as the library allows). Write no persistence code.

## story cli-entry
summary:      Build the cli package entry point: dispatch, exit-code mapping, and diagnostic channel.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliEntry.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     cli.main, cli.testing.cli_runner
depends:      foundation, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement main(argv) -> int with a command table, exit codes 0 to 4, CSV writing to stdout with
  LF endings, and one diagnostic line to stderr on failure. Commands register into the table; this
  story registers none.

## story ledger-core
summary:      Provide shared amount parsing and formatting, field validators, date validation, and the projected-balance guard.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-LedgerCore.md
stack:        python.md, persistence.md
provides:     parse_amount, format_amount, validate_code, validate_text, validate_date, balance_guard
depends:      foundation, database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement integer-cent parsing of -?DIGITS[.D[D]] (never zero), two-decimal output with leading
  minus and no separators, code/name/memo validators, real calendar date check, and a guard that
  computes the resulting per-account balances for a proposed change set before any write.

## story init
summary:      Implement `ledger init` to drop and recreate the three tables.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Init.md
covers:       SCHEMA-001
accepts:      st-003
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger init
depends:      cli-entry, ledger-core
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Drop all three tables if present and create them empty, writing nothing to stdout.

## story count
summary:      Implement `ledger count` reporting row counts per table.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Count.md
covers:       SCHEMA-002
accepts:      st-003
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger count
depends:      init
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Print table,rows then accounts, categories, transactions. Extra arguments are a usage error.

## story load-accounts
summary:      Implement `ledger load accounts <csv>`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md
covers:       SCHEMA-003
accepts:      st-004
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger load accounts
depends:      init, count
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Require the header to match the table columns, validate every row before writing, write all rows
  in one transaction, and print table,loaded then accounts,<n>.

## story load-categories
summary:      Implement `ledger load categories <csv>`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-LoadCategories.md
covers:       SCHEMA-004
accepts:      st-004
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger load categories
depends:      init, count
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Same contract as load accounts for the categories table; print table,loaded then categories,<n>.

## story load-transactions
summary:      Implement `ledger load transactions <csv>` keeping file txn_ids.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md
covers:       SCHEMA-005
accepts:      st-004
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger load transactions
depends:      load-accounts, load-categories
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Validate every row (account and category exist, amount, date, memo, no duplicate txn_id in the
  file or table) and the resulting non-negative balances before the first write. Print
  table,loaded then transactions,<n>.

## story load-rejection
summary:      Prove an invalid load is rejected atomically with exit 3.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-LoadRejection.md
covers:       SCHEMA-006
accepts:      st-007
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     atomic load rejection
depends:      load-transactions
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Ensure a file with an invalid row (unknown account, duplicate key, bad amount) stores none of its
  rows and exits 3, and that reloading existing keys is rejected with tables unchanged.

## story account-add
summary:      Implement `ledger account add`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-AccountAdd.md
covers:       ACCT-001
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger account add
depends:      init, count, ledger-core
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Validate code and name, create the account, print the account row with 0 transactions and 0.00.
  Code over 12 chars or outside A-Z0-9, and names over 40 chars or with comma or newline, exit 3.

## story account-get
summary:      Implement `ledger account get`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-AccountGet.md
covers:       ACCT-002
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger account get
depends:      account-add
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Print the account row with its transaction count and balance computed from the database; exit 4
  when absent.

## story account-rename
summary:      Implement `ledger account rename`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-AccountRename.md
covers:       ACCT-003
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger account rename
depends:      account-get
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Change only the name, validate it, print the updated row; exit 4 when absent.

## story account-delete
summary:      Implement `ledger account delete`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-AccountDelete.md
covers:       ACCT-004
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger account delete
depends:      account-get, load-transactions
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Print deleted and the code; exit 3 while the account has transactions; exit 4 when absent.

## story account-duplicate
summary:      Reject a duplicate account code.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-AccountDuplicate.md
covers:       ACCT-005
accepts:      st-007
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     duplicate account rejection
depends:      account-add
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Adding an existing code exits 3 and leaves the accounts table unchanged.

## story txn-post
summary:      Implement `ledger txn post`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-TxnPost.md
covers:       TXN-001
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger txn post
depends:      account-add, load-categories
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Assign max(txn_id)+1 or 1, store integer cents, print the transaction row. Memo is optional, up
  to 60 chars, no comma or newline. Unknown account, zero amount, or bad memo exits 3.

## story txn-get
summary:      Implement `ledger txn get`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-TxnGet.md
covers:       TXN-002
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger txn get
depends:      txn-post
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Print the transaction row; exit 4 when absent.

## story txn-amend
summary:      Implement `ledger txn amend`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-TxnAmend.md
covers:       TXN-003
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger txn amend
depends:      txn-get
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Change only the amount, check the resulting balance before writing, print the updated row. A
  negative-balance result exits 3 and changes nothing; exit 4 when absent.

## story txn-delete
summary:      Implement `ledger txn delete`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-TxnDelete.md
covers:       TXN-004
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger txn delete
depends:      txn-get
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Print deleted and the id; exit 4 when absent. Check the resulting balance before deleting.

## story txn-validate
summary:      Validate transaction post inputs.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-TxnValidate.md
covers:       TXN-005
accepts:      st-007
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     txn post validation
depends:      txn-post
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Unknown category, an amount such as 1.234, and a date such as 2026-02-30 each exit 3 before any
  write.

## story transfer
summary:      Implement `ledger transfer`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Transfer.md
covers:       XFER-001
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger transfer
depends:      txn-post
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write two TRANSFER rows atomically: -amount on from with memo "transfer to <to>" taking the next
  id, then +amount on to with memo "transfer from <from>". Non-positive amount, identical accounts,
  or unknown account exits 3 and writes neither row.

## story transfer-overdraw
summary:      Reject a transfer that would overdraw the source.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-TransferOverdraw.md
covers:       XFER-002
accepts:      st-008
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     transfer overdraw rejection
depends:      transfer, load-transactions
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  A transfer exceeding the source balance exits 3 with no rows written.

## story balance-rule
summary:      Assemble and verify the non-negative balance rule across every mutating command.
type:         feature
kind:         integration
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-BalanceRule.md
covers:       BAL-001
accepts:      st-007, st-008
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     non-negative balance rule
depends:      txn-post, txn-amend, txn-delete, transfer-overdraw, load-rejection
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Confirm post, amend, delete, transfer, and load each reject a change leaving any balance below
  zero with exit 3 before any write; wire the shared guard into any command that lacks it.

## story report-balances
summary:      Implement `ledger report balances`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ReportBalances.md
covers:       RPT-001
accepts:      st-005
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger report balances
depends:      load-transactions
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Compute per-account transaction count and balance from the database, ordered by code, then a
  TOTAL row. Two-decimal formatting from integer cents.

## story report-categories
summary:      Implement `ledger report categories`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ReportCategories.md
covers:       RPT-002
accepts:      st-005
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger report categories
depends:      load-transactions
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Per category including those with no transactions: count, inflow, outflow (positive), net, then a
  TOTAL row.

## story report-monthly
summary:      Implement `ledger report monthly`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-ReportMonthly.md
covers:       RPT-003
accepts:      st-005
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     ledger report monthly
depends:      load-transactions
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Per YYYY-MM with transactions, ascending, with count, inflow, outflow, net, then a TOTAL row.

## story cli-usage
summary:      Return exit 2 for usage errors.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-UsageErrors.md
covers:       CLI-001
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     usage error contract
depends:      load-accounts, report-balances, account-add, txn-post, transfer, count
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Unknown command, unknown load table, unknown report, and wrong argument counts for every command
  exit 2, with nothing on stdout and one stderr line.

## story cli-output
summary:      Enforce the stdout and stderr output contract.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-OutputContract.md
covers:       CLI-002
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     output contract
depends:      account-add, txn-post, report-balances
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Success writes unquoted CSV with a header and LF endings; init writes nothing; failures write
  nothing to stdout and one diagnostic line to stderr.

## story cli-database
summary:      Resolve the database from DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_PATH, or data/app.db.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-DatabaseResolution.md
covers:       CLI-003
accepts:      st-009
stack:        python.md, cli.md, persistence.md
provides:     database resolution
depends:      init, count
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Resolve in order DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_PATH, data/app.db. postgres:// and postgresql:// select
  PostgreSQL; anything else is a SQLite path, optionally with sqlite:// prefix. No driver is opened
  outside the shipped persistence library; amounts stay integer cents.

## story test-suite
summary:      Provide bin/test.sh running the application's own pytest suite.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-TestSuite.md
covers:       TEST-001
accepts:      st-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     bin/test.sh
depends:      load-rejection, account-delete, account-rename, account-duplicate, txn-validate, txn-delete, txn-amend, transfer-overdraw, report-categories, report-monthly, cli-usage, cli-output, cli-database, balance-rule
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Write a POSIX sh bin/test.sh that activates the environment and runs pytest from the application
  root, exiting zero only when all pass. Write tests covering each command, each exit code, and
  each rule against a temporary database.

## story verification
summary:      Run the supplied grader as the terminal release check.
type:         feature
kind:         integration
phase:        3
implements:   VERIFICATION.md
accepts:      st-001, st-005
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     release verification
depends:      test-suite, balance-rule, init, count, load-accounts, load-categories, load-transactions, account-add, account-get, txn-post, txn-get, transfer, report-balances, report-categories, report-monthly, cli-usage, cli-output, cli-database
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Assemble the finished ledger and run `sh sources/run.sh` unfiltered, declared Suite: full, asserting
  exit zero. Do not edit anything under sources/.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
